Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly classified Da Nang as part of the Southern region of Vietnam. In reality, Da Nang is located in the Central region of Vietnam (Miền Trung). This misclassification led to the incorrect conclusion that the Zone 5 Military Museum is in the same region (Southern Vietnam) as An Phú. The Planner failed to verify the regional classification of Da Nang accurately, which was critical to solving the problem correctly.
